description: Angular component class for digital gauge widget settings in a dashboard application, including form initialization, validation, and UI logic.

classes.name: DigitalGaugeWidgetSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing digital gauge widget settings, including form controls, validation, and UI interactions.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for widget settings.

methods.name: onSettingsSet
methods.description: Initializes form controls based on provided widget settings.

methods.name: prepareOutputSettings
methods.description: Prepares and returns the widget settings object based on form values.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form controls that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current settings and validation logic.

methods.name: doUpdateSettings
methods.description: Updates form controls with new settings data.

methods.name: prepareTicksValueFormArray
methods.description: Creates a form array for tick values.

methods.name: tickValuesFormArray
methods.description: Returns the form array of tick values.

methods.name: trackByTickValue
methods.description: Track function for tick value form array items.

methods.name: removeTickValue
methods.description: Removes a tick value at specified index.

methods.name: addTickValue
methods.description: Adds a new tick value to the form array.

methods.name: tickValueDrop
methods.description: Handles drag-and-drop reordering of tick values.

methods.name: _valuePreviewFn
methods.description: Generates a string preview of a value, optionally with units.
